description: This file defines the singleton ShopRepository for an Android Kotlin app, managing product catalog, cart, favorites, and preferences for an online shopping platform. It includes mock data, LiveData state management, local persistence, and paging logic without network calls.

classes.name: ShopRepository
classes.description: A singleton object that provides data access, caching, and persistence for products, categories, cart, and user preferences for an online shopping app.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CatalogPreferences
classes.description: Stores user-selected filters and sorting options for the product catalog.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CatalogQuery
classes.description: Represents the parameters defining a catalog browsing session, including filters and search query.

classes.name: ShopRepository.PagedProducts
classes.description: Contains a page of product items along with pagination info, used for mock paging.

classes.name: ShopRepository.CartItem
classes.description: Represents a product and its quantity within the cart.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Returns the mock list of product categories.

methods.name: getAllProducts
methods.description: Returns the list of all mock products.

methods.name: findProductById
methods.description: Finds and returns a product by its ID.

methods.name: getCategoryName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of a category by ID.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the repository from context, restoring persisted state. Must be called before using LiveData.

methods.name: cartLiveData
methods.description: Provides LiveData observing the current cart state.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Adds a specified quantity of a product to the cart.

methods.name: setQuantity
methods.description: Sets the quantity of a specific product in the cart; removes if zero or less.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Empties the cart.

methods.name: cartItems
methods.description: Returns list of CartItem objects representing current cart contents.

methods.name: cartTotalCents
methods.description: Calculates total price of cart items in cents.

methods.name: getRecentSearches
methods.description: Returns list of recent search queries.

methods.name: recordSearchQuery
methods.description: Records a search query into recent searches, de-duplicated and capped.

methods.name: clearRecentSearches
methods.description: Clears all recent search history.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a product ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles favorite status for a product ID.

methods.name: getFavorites
methods.description: Returns current set of favorite product IDs.

methods.name: observeFavorites
methods.description: Returns LiveData observing favorite IDs.

methods.name: loadCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Loads persisted catalog filter and sort preferences.

methods.name: saveCatalogPreferences
methods.description: Persists current catalog filter and sort preferences.

methods.name: getCatalogFirstPage
methods.description: Loads the first page of catalog results matching a query, with simulated delay.

methods.name: getCatalogNextPage
methods.description: Loads subsequent page for current query or resets if query changed.

methods.name: buildCatalogFilteredSorted
methods.description: Filters and sorts products based on catalog query parameters.

methods.name: relevanceScore
methods.description: Calculates a relevance score for a product relative to a search query.

methods.name: producePage
methods.description: Creates a page of products from the filtered/sorted list.
